voices.name: en05b_n1_A
voices.line: You close someone's feed, and suddenly your whole day feels small.

voices.name: en05b_n1_B
voices.line: You close someone's feed, and suddenly your whole day feels small.

voices.name: en05b_n2_A
voices.line: Marcus Aurelius ruled the Roman Empire. There was no one above him to envy. And yet, in his private journal, he wrote this.

voices.name: en05b_n2_B
voices.line: Marcus Aurelius ruled the Roman Empire. There was no one above him to envy. And yet, in his private journal, he wrote this.

voices.name: en05b_e3_A
voices.line: How much trouble he avoids, who does not look to see what his neighbor says, or does, or thinks.

voices.name: en05b_e3_B
voices.line: How much trouble he avoids, who does not look to see what his neighbor says, or does, or thinks.

voices.name: en05b_n4_A
voices.line: Every minute spent watching their life is a minute taken from yours. So he added one more line.

voices.name: en05b_n4_B
voices.line: Every minute spent watching their life is a minute taken from yours. So he added one more line.

voices.name: en05b_e5_A
voices.line: Look only to what you do yourself, that it may be just.

voices.name: en05b_e5_B
voices.line: Look only to what you do yourself, that it may be just.

voices.name: en05b_end_A
voices.line: Tonight's task. Instead of checking on others, write down one thing you did today.

voices.name: en05b_end_B
voices.line: Tonight's task. Instead of checking on others, write down one thing you did today.
